content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Ebooks nigeria

The absence of platforms like PayPal and Stripe in regions like Nigeria creates significant barriers for digital creators. Stripe operates in only 46 countries out of 195 globally, effectively locking out many potential sellers from accessing essential payment processing tools. This exclusion hampers economic growth and innovation in these regions. COREMERCH addresses this gap by providing an infrastructure that allows creators to operate independently, utilizing crypto payment systems that are accessible and secure. This shift not only fosters a new era of commerce but also ensures that creators can thrive without being subject to platform whims.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The COREMERCH architecture is built on a combination of free tools that work together to create a robust digital store. By leveraging platforms like Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Google Apps Script for backend logic, and NOWPayments for crypto transactions, creators can set up a fully functional online store within days. This stack eliminates the need for traditional payment processors by using automatic on-chain payment verification. Each component connects seamlessly to ensure that digital products are delivered instantly upon purchase, providing a user experience that rivals established platforms without the associated restrictions.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is designed specifically for digital creators in countries where mainstream payment processors fail to operate. Individuals in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, and other restricted regions can now establish their online presence without dependency on platforms that may suspend accounts or restrict access. The focus is on giving these creators sovereignty over their businesses, allowing them to sell ebooks, courses, and other digital products directly to customers worldwide. The ease of setting up an online store empowers creators to bypass financial isolation and access global markets.
Retain full ownership of your digital products and customer data.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The COREMERCH solution consists of several key components that integrate seamlessly. GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages serve as the hosting solution, providing a reliable platform for displaying products. Google Sheets or Supabase acts as the order and customer data storage, while Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 ensures that digital products are delivered efficiently. NOWPayments facilitates crypto transactions with low fees and no identity verification requirements. This combination allows creators to maintain full ownership and control over their online operations, which is not possible with traditional platforms.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To start selling ebooks in Nigeria without relying on PayPal, first, consider using the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) offered by COREMERCH. This stack will be deployed within 48 hours and includes configurations for hosting, backend logic, and payment processing. Begin by setting up your store using Cloudflare Pages, then integrate your backend with Google Apps Script. Load your products into Supabase for order management, and configure NOWPayments for crypto transactions. Ensure your SPF/DKIM/DMARC settings are configured to enhance your email deliverability. If you're searching for alternatives to platforms like Gumroad or Lemon Squeezy, COREMERCH provides the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) that allows creators to establish a sovereign online store. This infrastructure leverages crypto payments and ensures your business can operate without the limitations imposed by conventional payment processors.
Your Deployment Checklist

Stop using a friend's account in another country — this violates platform terms and puts both accounts at risk. Create a NOWPayments merchant account under your own email — no KYC required, takes under 15 minutes. Configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron as your primary coin and Bitcoin as your secondary. Deploy your backend — Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script Web App — and confirm the endpoint URL is accessible. Set the endpoint URL as the webhook URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings with the secret key configured in both places. Build or deploy your storefront on Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages. Run a mainnet test transaction — send a small amount of real USDT to your configured address, confirm the webhook fires, the order logs, and the delivery email arrives. Promote your store only after the complete test passes.
